name: smwgraphics-mario-wario-ice-cavern
title: Mario & Wario - Ice Cavern
description:
A very big ice cavern background, from the japanese game Mario & Wario, for the SNES. A great fit for ice caves. This background is perfect for levels with a lot of verticality, so I recommend to use it in very high cavern levels.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
